description: Fixed the initialization mapping bug where `self.x` and `self.x0` in the `Block` class were incorrectly assigned to forward pass parameters (`self.x`, `self.x0`) instead of the class dictionary `self.resid_lambdas`. This caused the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to fail initialization on the first step, crashing the training loop and reducing the val_bpb to 0.9910.
